description: Deletes a Shared Table at once, for everyone who has the link. This cannot be undone. Use it only when the user explicitly asks to delete this table, and pass confirm: true. Without deletion a table expires 30 days after the last change anyway.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

link.description: The full table link including the part after #.
